_about: A REAL answer from POST /api/p5play-convert (deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash on OpenRouter), recorded 2026-11-17 from the p5play program in p5play-demo-input.js; it ran 120 frames clean in scripts/moshion-harness.mjs. The 2026-11-p5play-convert What's New clip replays it so recording spends no credit and needs no key.
notes: `shapeColor` is just `color` in moSHion, and colours are written as CSS text like `'rgb(255, 184, 108)'`.
p5play's `overlap()` let the star fall through the basket; here both sprites get `collider = 'none'` and we ask `star.overlaps(basket)` each frame.
Moving the basket and checking the star moved from `draw()` into `update()`.
`drawSprites()` is gone — the engine draws the sprites itself.
The score text moved into `drawTop()` so it shows on top of everything.
